steps.label: push
steps.run: L="$HOME/ShortsRenderAgent/music/lib"; a=""; for n in Crusade_-_Heavy_Industry Rising_Tide Stay_the_Course Lost_Time Reawakening Past_the_Edge; do f=$(find "$L" -name "$n.mp3" | head -1); [ -n "$f" ] && a="$a $f ship/music_$n.mp3"; done; echo $a; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a
